title: 天皇賞（秋）の後に・先に続くこの道よ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Inari One loses the autumn Tenno Sho, but it still makes for a good experience leading up to the Tokyo Daishoten.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We renew our spirits and aim to return to Oi Racecourse one day.
